built: GET /job/{sid}/{pos}/vision: the panel (HTMX lazy-loads it into the result page; empty 200 when the job has no stored payload or is not released, so the loader disappears)
GET /job/{sid}/{pos}/view?scope=S: the result page with the panel open, a diagram of scope S (the svg, via ), a refused/failed export shown as a message with no file offered
GET /job/{sid}/{pos}/download/{fmt}?scope=S[&inline=1]: pwml|sbml|sbgn|kgml|svg|html as attachment (inline only for svg, for the ); refused export -> 422 error page, no file
POST /job/{sid}/{pos}/rescope: form fields message and scope -> rescope() -> 303 to /view?scope=<new>; empty message keeps the scope; same CSRF guard as /submit

serve.run_generate(run_dir, slug, fmt): one child process (python -m t2pw.vision.serve) per (job, scope) that writes all six public formats into <attempt out dir>/vision_cache/, behind a process-wide lock; refusal recorded as <scope>.refused
Scope slugs are canonical (paper|default|full|hops:N, N 0..10; hops:1 is default, deeper than 10 is full); anything else is 400. fmt must be one of six names, else 400.

design.access: register() receives app.py's own _item (job lookup: sid format, position range, unknown job -> 404), _page and _cross_site, so every route has exactly the access rules of /job/{sid}/{pos}/file/{kind}. The run dir is <work_root>/item-<id>/attempt-<item.attempt>/out, only when the item is finished and release_ready/review_required (the PWML download's own gate) and final_mapped.json resolves inside item-<id>. No path comes from the URL.
design.production_db: generate._offline() blanks the DB variables and is a process-wide env swap. The server never calls it: the child calls generate(..., offline=False) (VD-15, public keyword; default offline=True unchanged), so the quarantine step and the PWML export both see the DB variables the parent passed; the file cache is vision_cache/v<serve.CACHE_VERSION>/ (bump the constant by hand to retire old files); T2PW_OFFLINE_CURATOR=1 is passed in the child's explicit env (no LLM on a view request). The parent's os.environ is never written.
design.serialisation: threading.Lock in serve.py: one child at a time per server process. A waiter re-checks the cache inside the lock and starts nothing if the first child produced its files. SINGLE-WORKER ASSUMPTION (VD-15): several uvicorn workers would each have their own lock; run one worker process. A lock file is the upgrade (documented in serve.py).
design.review_round_1: Static review (F1, F3, F4, F6 fixed; F2, F5 noted under open_questions). F1: the lock wait is bounded (serve.LOCK_WAIT_S = 30 s) and raises serve.Busy without touching a lock it does not hold; the download route answers 503 + Retry-After 30, the view page shows the message. F3: _child snapshots the env it was passed, imports postpipeline (which loads .env with override=True) FIRST, then re-applies the passed env and forces T2PW_OFFLINE_CURATOR=1. F4: the .refused marker and every format file are written atomically (tmp + os.replace); only a message starting with one of serve._GENUINE (the export's own refusal texts) is remembered, anything else (DB or deployment error, e.g. a connection failure) exits 3 and is retried on the next request. F6: CACHE_VERSION moved from generate.py to serve.py; generate.py's only change is the offline keyword.
design.rescope_llm: VD-15: no LLM on a request thread. web_routes passes llm=_no_llm (always raises) to rescope(), so only the keyword table runs. LLM re-scoping can move into the serialised child process later.
design.stored_payload: the child uses <run_dir>/big_payload.json when it exists (an extension was merged), else big_from_run(run_dir) (final_mapped.json). Nothing writes big_payload.json yet; that is the extension lane.
design.choose_scope_hook: Scope chooser on submission is out of scope. Later: the job form posts a free-text request; app._process_submission calls choose_scope(text) (t2pw.vision.scope; LLM then keyword fallback, never raises) in the threadpool AFTER the rate limit, stores web_routes.slug_of(spec) with the item (a new column or a key in the stored request), and the result page reads it as the default scope: _panel(view, stored_slug) in vision_panel(), and the 'default' fallback in scope_arg() / the links in _vision_panel.html become that slug. web_routes.slug_of() already maps a ScopeSpec to the canonical slug and scope_arg() parses it back, so no new parsing is needed.

Cost of a first view: one child process runs the PWML export once and then six formats (including quarantine) under the lock; with the curator offline this should be seconds to a minute, but the real time is not measured yet (command 3).

Review note F2: on timeout, serve.py's subprocess.run kills only the direct child. That is not a tree kill like the worker's Job Object (web/worker.py:109-184), and the child is orphaned if the server dies. Acceptable today, because the export path spawns no processes. Reuse the worker's child wrapper if that changes.

Review note F5: with offline=False, generate's _kept runs a second DB-backed quarantine apart from the one inside run_pwml_export. The settings are the same, but if the DB flips between the two calls, SBML/SBGN/KGML could keep a different graph than the PWML. Rare; no change now.

The refusal whitelist (serve._GENUINE) is a message-prefix match; a reworded export message would be reported as an error and retried instead of remembered (safe direction). Upgrade: a structured error kind from run_pwml_export.
serve.CACHE_VERSION is bumped by hand: forgetting it after an exporter change leaves old jobs on stale files.
Cross-format names (V6 F1b) are not touched here; the panel offers the files as generate() produces them.
